reviews.text: App glitches when you hit profile. Won’t let you cancel membership or subscription.

reviews.title: BS
reviews.text: I used the app and thought it was great but I only used it for a month. I cancelled the subscription and they have been charging me for the last six months continuously. My card carrier cancelled the subscription. They have two different buttons to cancel subscription and only one of them works but they keep charging you. I use iPhone and I have cancelled multiple times and also cancelled them through my bank but they keep trying to charge me. It is unfortunate because this could be a good app without all the cash grab bs.

reviews.title: Total rip off
reviews.text: If I could give it a half are I would.  I did not really like program so I sent an email in January telling them to cancel my subscription.  According to my Apple subscription list, I have been inactive since March yet, I’m still getting invoiced in September.  When I called about it, they offered 50% discount of the last invoice and that was it.  DO NOT SUBSCRIBE TO THIS APP

reviews.title: Fraud, will charge you in spite of cancellation
reviews.text: First of all, they charged me twice for the same subscription. I had to flag it through credit card company. When I canceled the subscription, they still kept one of those two records active and kept charging me for that subscription.  when I contacted the support, they asked me to dispute the transaction with the credit card company, and said they will cooperate. They DID NOT. It has been a hassle getting refund back from this unethical company. It’s a disgrace.

reviews.title: Transformative
reviews.text: Impossible to describe. I know in my bones this is an amazing approach, but I cannot tell you why it is working for me. At this moment I am not feeling anxious about my weight. This lack of anxiety is a huge change for me. I'm excited for the future!

reviews.title: Changes you from the inside.
reviews.text: I saw this advertisement on YouTube an the idea behind this is so simple. Made since to my mind. Retrain your subconscious and results will follow. This is my third day and I don’t have the food noise in my mind that I had become so use to hearing. I have observed my making better choices for food without me trying. I’m feeling more positive about me. I am a 56 yr old  black woman. The sessions aren’t long. This is day 3, I will keep you posted on my journey.

reviews.title: Customer service
reviews.text: I had an incredible experience with their customer service! They responded almost immediately, they were compassionate and understanding. And they did all they could and quickly helped resolve my issue. Customer service like this is fundamental and hard to find!

reviews.title: Money Scam
reviews.text: Downloaded the app and was happy to do the free trial. After realizing this was not for me, I cancelled through Apple settings (like many other subscription based apps). Seemed to work and I thought nothing of it. Realized that I’ve been continuously charged through PayPal for the past year (even though this does not show in my app subscriptions). Finally (hopefully) I’ve been cancelled via email, but I would like a refund for the scam-worthy charges over the past year. This is a dishonest business practice and should be illegal.

reviews.title: Shady For Sure
reviews.text: I decided to listen to “increase water intake” during my awake time.  I found this to be a bit alarming.  The main theme was OK until the final words were to relax and enjoy IN HELL.  I stopped my subscription immediately and deleted it from my phone.  Be sure to listen while you are awake before you trust what they are saying.  Would not recommend

reviews.title: Run!!!!! Faster!!!
reviews.text:
Update:
After some back and forth the app did issue a full refund which I am very grateful for. I’ve added one star since I did not get robbed. 

My experience with this app has been horrible from the start. It made me want to smoke MORE, not less. The constant notifications, the robotic voices, it just reminded me of smoking All. The. Time. 
But most importantly, I signed at a discounted price for 30 day access. Just 30 days. But to my surprise today I was charged another $43!! I thought it would be fine, most companies just give a refund especially since it was still pending. Nope!! They basically said hate it for you. You would have had to notify us a while ago. 
So please don’t get robbed like me. RUN!!!!

reviews.title: didn’t work, poor customer service
reviews.text: I was hopeful that hypnotherapy would help me, but I did not see any results. I tried to cancel my subscription before it auto renewed, but my login would not work, and there was no option to reset my password. it auto renewed and I contacted them to ask for a refund and they refused. I asked for an exception due to my technical issues and they offered me a 50% refund. I still do not think that is acceptable.

reviews.title: I can tell a difference.

Very glad I got this app.  I didn’t know what else to do and was at the end of my rope.   Thank you very much!!!

reviews.title: Miss the infinite loop that played all night.
reviews.text: I love this app and have been using it over a year. It has helped reduce cravings and I’ve lost over 50 pounds with this, diet and exercise. I do however miss the infinite loop of affirmations. It used to play all night. Now even on infinite loop it stops. I’m one of those people that needs noise to sleep so once it stops, I’m awake! I was sleeping so good for a while but since the change it has affected the quality of sleep since I wake up and have to put it back on a few times a night.

First, I weighed myself 278 disappointed, because that day I was under control and snacking and snacking, then I started my‘s. I turned it on. It was 9:30 PM and I started listening and I went into a deep sleep that I did not wake up until the next day five in the morning. I was so excited. that  I had slept. And in the morning I got on the scale. I dropped 5 pounds.
incredible but It Works!

reviews.title: Unsure about this app.
reviews.text: I know different people respond differently to things such as hipnosis, but since I’ve gotten this app I have not had one decent, or even fair night of sleep. The voice is soothing, the vocabulary and speech also affirming, however…I have lost an incredible amount of sleep since starting this. I’m going to try it for a little longer but not happy with what I’ve paid for. If I continue not sleeping I’ll be contacting the developer or who ever for a refund. Disappointed 😔

reviews.title: Only one problem for me
reviews.text: I do like using Kure in my desire to lose weight. The meditations are good UNTIL, in the affirmations, it always says I feel sexier. My journey has nothing to do with being sexy. I have sexual trauma in my past and every time I hear that voice say that, it snaps me out of the trance. I may have to stop using it.

reviews.title: Really difficult to cancel
reviews.text:
I’m trying to cancel my subscription. I keep getting routed to a page to enter my email. After I enter that in nothing happens. No email ever comes with further instructions. When you click support on here it goes to a defunct Instagram account. When I click on the support button after I enter my email it just takes me to a terms document. It’s shady as h$@. Lesson learned DO NOT sign up with aps that take payment outside of the App Store.
UPDATE:
After seeing the developer’s response on here I emailed them. The email (written by AI) gave me the same instructions  to cancel that I HAVE ALREADY TRIED. Multiple times. I have input every email I’ve ever used and have still not received a follow-up email that somehow lets me move forward with canceling. I’ve requested to interact with an actual person; we’ll see how that goes.
